dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: So there you are... Boss...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's where... you were...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And that's... whose body you're using.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The moment I got tired and could feel my soul being sucked out,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: you said you had to go because things were going south...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's true...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: If you're there, Boss...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We're going to win for sure...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I'm so lonely...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Could you... call me again...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: like you always have?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Boss...

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: No one can escape the fate that was chosen for them.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: All that remains is the end, where you will all perish.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: Eternal greatness exists only within myself.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: Sing a song of sorrow in a world where time has vanished.

dialogue.name: JoJo-EpTitle,Sign
dialogue.speech: Episodio Diavolo Surfaces

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Mista! Hurry up and pierce your Stand with this arrow!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What's going on? Requiem's suddenly heading toward us.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Stop Requiem!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I can't! It's too far away!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HCCF&\c&HB&}Crack

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wha—

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: My g*n...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What are you doing, Mista?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: It's because you're touching the arrow!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: No way! Why is this...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Let go of it, Mr. Polnareff!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Let go of the arrow!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Glad I took that cop's Beretta just in case.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: But what the hell, b*ll*ts?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Why'd my revolver break all of a sudden?

dialogue.name: Five
dialogue.speech: M-Maybe the boss got close?

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: You dumbass! Think before you talk, Number Five!

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: Are you saying you saw someone coming close to us in this big, open space?

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: We didn't see anyone at the moment the revolver broke.

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: It's metal fatigue.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's because he's been overusing the g*n.

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: The axis of the cylinder broke.

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: We haven't had a chance to doany maintenance or inspections!

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: H-Hey!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What the hell is this thing's problem? It's heading toward m-me!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: No, Mista. It's heading towards me.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Even though it has the arrow back...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HCBBC&\c&HEB&}Batoom

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Requiem intends to finish me because I touched the arrow.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mista, run!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Reload, b*ll*ts! Reload the g*n!

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: This isn't a revolver! We need another cartridge!

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: It'll take time to reload it!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I-It's no use...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I'm finished...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I'm throwing it! Catch it, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I'm gonna throw the turtle to you!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Mr. Polnareff!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You okay, Mr. Polnareff?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's okay. B-But... how?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Mista, do you remember what I said back at the Colosseum?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: There's still more to Requiem's ability that I'm not aware of.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But I'm starting to understand.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Requiem stopped because the starting time has come.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The starting time?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Yes.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It's because

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: my body has started to change!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: That's why it stopped trying to k*ll me!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: This is Requiem's true motive, now that it's gone berserk.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The ability to make beings swap souls,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: meaning the ability that makes them start to change into something else.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The prelude is over, and the actual piece is now starting to play,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so it gave up on k*lling me.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The .-billion-year history of this world's creatures is starting to change

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: into something else within a matter of hours.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: All of it!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I see...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: So that's what makes Requiem so truly frightening.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: However...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Thanks to them, I was able to see it.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I'm starting to understand the answer.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I'm close to figuring out how to get that arrow from Requiem!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I'm realizing the method!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wh-What the hell is going on?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What's up with this ability?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: How far has this damn thing spread?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: It doesn't look like they're dying or in pain...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Everyone just has these vacant stares.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: But there is this fear of becoming something else.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The fear that, slowly but surely, both my body and my soul are going to disappear.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Trish!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I-I'm fine. But...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The starting time is imminent.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It will happen differently for each of us, but it'll start soon,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: for all of us.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We don't have much time left...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That's what you're saying?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Polnareff! This is happening because you brought the arrow!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: You said it had the power to defeat the boss,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: but instead, you basically ended us!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Stop! This is far beyond anyone's expectations.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: It's more important that we find a way to defeat Requiem.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: That's right. Good. Get closer.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Get closer to Requiem!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: If we get closer, I'll be able to fully see Requiem's secrets, because I'm right here.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: The arrow's power will become mine, and the world will grovel at my feet!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: After it!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Good!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Don't move, Mista!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Trish, Bucciarati! Both of you stay where you are!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Stay right there!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wha—

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I just told you not to move, Mista!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We can catch up to Requiem in a second!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What the hell? Shut up, you dumbass!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: My body's disappearing already!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I picked up your revolver.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The one that you said broke a moment ago.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This broken part doesn't match up correctly with the rest of it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If it just broke due to metal fatigue, they should still fit together.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What are you getting at, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, I need you to stay right there, too!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We need to keep a distance from each other!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You dumbass! Requiem is getting away!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The b*ll*ts said it was metal fatigue, so it's metal fatigue!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I have a new Beretta, too!

dialogue.name: B*llet
dialogue.speech: The parts aren't matching up because a piece flew off!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That could be...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But it could be something more.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We'll be able to tell as soon as we see this lost piece.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I gave a part of the g*n life and let it loose.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Moles are basically blind, but their sense of smell is unparalleled.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Looks like it's returned, and it found its lost piece.

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HBE&\c&HEF&}Fit

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, wait a sec!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Are you saying someone just used immense force to tear the g*n apart?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Listen up! The b*ll*ts and I are very clear on this!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: There's no one who got close to me in this square—

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You're exactly right. No one did.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's why we need to stay apart from each other,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: because his range is only a few meters!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Giorno, you...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No one got close to Narancia when he was attacked, either.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No one... other than us.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mr. Polnareff, if your guess is correct and the boss had two personalities,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: then he should be able to get in and out of another's mind freely.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Diavolo has inhabited one of us.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wha—

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If he stays hidden, Trish can't detect his existence.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The reason he's staying hidden now

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: is because he's waiting for us to obtain the arrow for good.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's why he also appeared for a brief moment to destroy the g*n.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: W-Wait a second!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I know I keep saying this, but stay away from me, Mista!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Stay out of his range!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: My g*n was destroyed!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You're the one closest to the g*n.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I-It's...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's not me!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: O-Oh, yeah. When Narancia was attacked...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The one closest to him was...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: sh*t. I must do something.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Requiem keeps moving farther away.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: This rookie, Giorno Giovanna...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He's hiding in one of us.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But despite that, we have one advantage.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Diavolo can make Emperor Crimson appear,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but he doesn't have complete control of the body he's inhabiting right now.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If he had total control

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: of the body he's currently inhabiting, he wouldn't just stay quietly hidden.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It's because he can't manifest and move around freely

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: that we all still live and haven't been eliminated.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: In a sense, we have him cornered.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's the turtle!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It was the closest one to my revolver!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Polnareff is the one who's possessed!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's not possible.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mr. Polnareff was almost k*lled by Requiem earlier,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: because the boss destroyed the revolver.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The boss won't let the body he's inhabiting be put in danger.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Plus...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I only sense one being's life force.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This turtle only has one soul in it.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: You can tell that, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Only if I can get closer and touch their body.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: How can you be so certain?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Life force is a mass.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If I actually touch someone, I can tell how many there are.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's no other way.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I have to touch each one of you and find out.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: But how are you going to get closer within Emperor Crimson's range?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I learned how to detect Emperor Crimson from Mr. Polnareff.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The moment the droplets suddenly increase is when time has skipped!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Correct.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But whether you can avoid his attack or not will be a matter of luck,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: as is whether you'll be able to just barely dodge it.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's definitely not me.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: When Narancia was k*lled, I was the farthest away.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Then I'll check you firstso we can be at ease.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Hey!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Stop right there! Stay away from me!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: D-Don't come any closer!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: If Diavolo is actually in you, what's going to happen to me?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: When Narancia died, his body was empty.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: My soul was able to travel from Narancia's body into my own,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: but it was empty.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's no chance that he's possessing me.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Oh, really?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: That's just what you're saying.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I have no way of confirming your ability.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Not to mention, Giorno,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: do you have a way to definitively confirm that you only have one soul?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You can't check yourself with your own ability, can you?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mista, we can't go after the arrow unless we find out!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Come any closer and I'll blow your limbs off!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Stop!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Check me first, Giorno.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Hurry up and do it!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: We're losing more and more time.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Just as you said,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: depending on how we look at the situation, we have the boss cornered.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: There's no other way.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Yes...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: We have to do this right now.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Someone's going to be attacked...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If we get closer to one another...

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HD&\c&HCFFB&}Slice

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Giorno!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: It's Mista!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: He was the one possessed!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Spicy Lady—

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: No, Trish!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: It's you!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: He got closer instantly by moving your body closer to him!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I've been waiting for this moment, my daughter...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: The moment you unleashed your Stand!

dialogue.name: Who_swapped_with,King
dialogue.speech: Diagram of swapped souls

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\pos(.,.)}Bucciarati

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\an\fs\pos(,)}His body has died(which means Doppio has also died)

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\an\pos(.,.)}Trish Mista

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\an\fs\pos(.,.)}Diavolo(Emperor Crimsonhad possessed him)

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\pos(.,)}Giorno

dialogue.name: Bucciarati,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\an\pos(.,.)}Turtle Polnareff

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: My daughter...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: If you hadn't revealed your Stand, I might've actually been cornered...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Zipper Man!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: If I can grab the Stand, I can also move the body.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Now I can at least make this body run.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: We're going to be attacked! Brace yourselves!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: He's going to make time leap—

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wha—

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: D-Don't tell me...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Why's he running without attacking us?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Through observation, he's already found

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: a way to get the arrow away from Requiem!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: There's no time! That takes priority!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Shoot, Mista!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Don't let him get there first, no matter what!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Stop wasting time!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This isn't the time to hesitate because that's your own body!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: That's not it...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I've already fired, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It seems that... I've already fired six shots.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He's running as he makes time leap!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He predicted the course of the b*ll*ts!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: After him! If he gets the arrow, we're finished!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: That shadow...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The reason no one can touch the arrow...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: If I'm correct...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: When I move, Requiem's shadow moves in the opposite direction from me,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: despite the location of the sun.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Which means...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: To that man, it should look like the shadow is stretching toward me.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: In Bucciarati's eyes, the shadow is stretching in front of Requiem.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Which means...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This shadow is in different places depending on the viewer!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This is the mystery of Requiem!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This is why it can control everyone's souls!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This thing is the shadow of one's soul.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Requiem itself is the shadow of my soul!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: That's why attacking it will mean attacking yourself!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: If we can get rid of this shadow, I can get the arrow!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: And...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: If it has a shadow, then my own light should be somewhere, as well!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: He still doesn't have the arrow!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: We're rushing in, Mista!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: The light is behind my own mind!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: He just destroyed something behind his head!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What in the world did he do?

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: Now I've got it...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: I, Diavolo, now have the arrow!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If Diavolo found a way to grasp the arrow, we should take advantage of it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Because the arm he tore off of me and these droplets of blood are all just particles.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind shall now

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: appear!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: These ants!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: What just happened?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This is good, so far.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Let's go...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We have to hurry.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Blast the arrow away from him! Don't let him grab it, Mista!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I'm already shooting!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: They made it through!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Despite him predicting their movements, we're still far apart.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He can only knock the ones coming at him out of their trajectory!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The rest of you knock that arrow back and bring it to me, b*ll*ts!

dialogue.name: Bull
dialogue.speech: H-He'd already thrown...

dialogue.name: Bull
dialogue.speech: ...a civilian into the air!

dialogue.name: Bull
dialogue.speech: He figured out the b*ll*ts would land and returned the arrow to its place!

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: The trash ability of an underling...

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: There's no way your weak mind can surpass Emperor Crimson's predictions.

dialogue.name: King
dialogue.speech: You will not be able to get through.
